title: Getting to watch Come From Away in a room full of Newfoundlanders aft...
transcript: I flew to Gander, Newfoundland to see Come From Away and today was the day of the show. But first we decided to do a little tour down to the coast. Unfortunately, the weather was horrible, but I do think it was kind of a rite of passage. We joined a group called Ghostlight Global who are here doing a come from away gander tour this week. They do a ton of theatre tours and we kept running into them, so it was fun to just actually spend day together. We went to Tullygate, which is a port city known for being, like, extraordinarily beautiful, and it really was. And I guess on nice days you can sometimes see whales and icebergs. But I very much enjoyed the salty sea air, even though I was so cold cause I did not pack a. That was definitely my fault. We then drove to the Och Island Winery, where we had a delicious lunch and did a wine tasting with some fantastically named wine like Kiss My Arse and 50 Shades of gay. I also bought the sweatshirt, which I'm obsessed with. This woman dawn, around the wine tasting, she was so funny. The wine was great. It was a good way to spend a rainy afternoon. We then drove back to Gander because it was time to get ready for the show. Every single person had recommended Rosies to me. So that's where we did our pre show dinner. The portions Were massive. The food was so good. This was small poutine. We then went to the community centre which is where the largest walk in refrigerator is. If you've seen come from away, also known as their hockey rink, it's very much not hockey season so I think it was a roller rink now. But it was really fun to see, especially cause they have all these photos and. And it really gave a feel for the community. I really love the Gander logo so much. Finally it was time to head to the theatre. I just could not believe we were seeing Come From Away. The entire theatre is so special and it's been in previews for a few weeks, but this was the official opening night. Had to put my New York pin in the map and then it was time for the show. Going to do a full separate video on this because I have so much to say, but let me tell you, this is one of the most magical, insane theater experiences I've ever had. I cried literally all of my makeup off. Watching Come From Away in a room full of Newfoundlanders is an experience everyone should get to have. We then headed to to the Gander airport for the after party. Side note I must own this Commander Gander goes to come from away book. I need to buy like 6 copies for all of my friends with kids anyway. I cannot believe you Can just throw a party at an airport in Gander. I love it. I have this 38 planes beer that I'm obsessed with. I did steal an empty can cause I wanna turn it into a vase. All the table settings were like scenes from the show and I was crying cause they were so cute. It's just been the most amazing trip and I can't believe it is almost over. I've met amazing people, I've Learned amazing stories. I just love this place so much and I'm so thankful I got to be here. If you're wondering, Come From Away is still, in fact, a perfect musical.
